title: How To Airflare The Easy Way - Bboy Trickey

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher breaks down advanced b-boy moves step-by-step with clear verbal instructions and on-screen text. He combines humor with technical breakdowns to explain prerequisites and common pitfalls.

lesson_structure.note: Demonstrating the three prerequisites: Monkey Swings, Swipes, and Tornadoes
First step: hand placement and leg crossing
Emphasizing the importance of waiting and timing in the airflare
Focusing on the catch and keeping hips elevated
Putting the three prerequisites and steps together
Showing common mistakes and how popping hips fixes them

cues: Leg crosses body in a diagonal line
The longer you wait, the faster you'll catch
Pike your legs towards your chest
common_mistakes: Dropping hips instead of popping them up
Going for a full 360 too early

what_works: Demonstrating what not to do with a partner
what_hinders: Advanced terminology without extensive foundational conditioning shown
